Class WebSocketMessageBrokerStats

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.socket.config.WebSocketMessageBrokerStats
All Implemented Interfaces:
SmartInitializingSingleton
public class WebSocketMessageBrokerStats extends Object implements SmartInitializingSingleton
A central class for aggregating information about internal state and counters from key infrastructure components of the setup that comes with @EnableWebSocketMessageBroker for Java config and <websocket:message-broker> for XML.

默认情况下，聚合信息每 30 分钟以 INFO 级别记录。可以通过setLoggingPeriod(long)更改记录频率。

该类由上述配置声明为 Spring 圈，名称为 "webSocketMessageBrokerStats"，并且可以轻松导出到 JMX，例如使用 MBeanExporter。

Since:
4.1
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev，Sam Brannen，Brian Clozel

    • setLoggingPeriod

      public void setLoggingPeriod(long period)
      Set the frequency for logging information at INFO level in milliseconds. If set 0 or less than 0, the logging task is cancelled.

      默认情况下，此属性设置为 30 分钟（30 * 60 * 1000）。

    • afterSingletonsInstantiated

      public void afterSingletonsInstantiated()
      描述从接口复制：SmartInitializingSingleton
      Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase, with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created already. ListableBeanFactory.getBeansOfType(Class) calls within this method won't trigger accidental side effects during bootstrap.

      注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

      Specified by:
      `afterSingletonsInstantiated` 接口 `SmartInitializingSingleton` 中
